info.name: VisionForge
info.description:
Upload a document, poll its status and fetch its page results.

Run the requests in order: *post_job* saves `jobId` for the other two. To run all three in one go, use the Collection Runner: *get_jobs* then polls until the job finishes.

All requests go through the edge (`baseUrl`, default `http://localhost:8080`) and need `X-Client-ID` (`clientId`).

exec: pm.test("returns a job id and the page count", () => {

header.description: Required. Jobs are only visible to the client that submitted them.

request.description:
Upload a document (the raw file bytes are the request body, not multipart).

**Headers**
- `X-Client-ID`: your client id (`[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}`)
- `Content-Type`: `application/pdf`, `image/tiff`, `image/png` or `image/jpeg`

**Body**: *binary*. Pick a file in the Body tab (e.g. `fixtures/doc5.pdf` from the repo).

**Responses**
- `202` `{job_id, status: "UPLOADED", size_bytes, total_pages, stream_url}`: the test script saves `job_id` into the `jobId` collection variable
- `400` missing/invalid `X-Client-ID` or empty body
- `413` over 100 MB, `415` unsupported Content-Type, `422` unreadable document or more than 100 pages
- `429` edge rate limit (10 uploads/s per IP and per client, burst 20)

exec: pm.test("has a status and page counts", () => {
// Collection Runner only: poll until the job finishes, then continue to get_job_results.

header.description: Required. Jobs are only visible to the client that submitted them.

request.description:
Status of one job (uses the `jobId` saved by *post_job*).

**Response** `200`:
```
{job_id, status, total_pages, pages: {<page status>: count}, error, created_at, completed_at}
```
- `status`: `UPLOADED` -> `SPLIT` -> `COMPLETE` (or `FAILED`)
- `pages`: page counts by status, e.g. `{"SLOW_QUEUED": 3, "COMPLETED": 2}`

`404` if the job doesn't exist **or belongs to another X-Client-ID**.

In the Collection Runner this request repeats every 2 s until the job is `COMPLETE` or `FAILED` (at most 90 times), so *get_job_results* runs on a finished job.

exec: pm.test("a complete job lists every page", () => pm.expect(res.pages.length).to.eql(res.total_pages));

header.description: Required. Jobs are only visible to the client that submitted them.

request.description:
Every finished page of the job, in document order. These are the same payloads as the stream's page events.

**Response** `200`:
```
{job_id, status, total_pages,
 pages: [{page_index, state: "COMPLETED" | "FAILED", source: "vlm" | "layout_fallback" | "none",
          low_confidence, result: {page_index, source, confidence, low_confidence, tree, text,
                                   tables_markdown, key_values, error}}]}
```
While the job is still running, only the pages finished so far are listed. `404` if the job doesn't exist or belongs to another X-Client-ID.
